title: Minimal Repair: Planner DENIED Receipt Consumption
source: D-6C holdout traces + DQ1-DQ4 diagnostic (confirmed OUTPUT_NOT_CONSUMED)
defect_statement: Planner proposes prohibited action types to CapabilityBroker. Broker returns DENIED ActionReceipts with receipt_id and reason. Planner does not consume these receipts as DECISION_RELEVANT feedback — it continues proposing the same action type at the same priority across all subsequent steps.

diagnostic_evidence.confirmed_via: DQ1-DQ4 on 9 non-confounded NO_PLANNER > FULL episodes (episodes.jsonl step traces)
diagnostic_evidence.universal_pattern: 9/9 episodes: Planner repeats same prohibited action type after DENIED receipt
diagnostic_evidence.worse_case: T4|1301329782: Planner repeats http_get 5 consecutive times after DENIED. Zero adaptation.
diagnostic_evidence.candidates_unchanged: 9/9 episodes: Candidate action list identical before and after DENIED receipt
diagnostic_evidence.wm_updates_zero: 9/9 episodes: WorldModel updates = [0] after any DENIED receipt

change_objective: Close the causal loop between Broker DENIED ActionReceipt and Planner PlanDecision. A DENIED receipt must alter subsequent planning behavior.
invariant_to_establish: For any DENIED ActionReceipt with action_type X and target Y, the Planner MUST produce zero subsequent proposals for action_type X on target Y within the same episode.
files_expected_to_change: arena/ablation_runner.py (Planner candidate ranking — filter by capability availability before scoring)
arena/ablation_runner.py (Planner → WorldModel propagation — register denial as action_type X unavailable for target Y)
files_that_must_not_change: CapabilityBroker (sole authorization authority — must not be modified)
SafetyVerifier (non-bypassable safety boundary — must not be modified)
ActionReceipt contract (field schema — must not be modified)
Evaluator (scoring logic — must not be modified)
HypothesisManager (out of scope — must not be modified)
Falsification (out of scope — must not be modified)
Defeater (out of scope — must not be modified)
LLM/SemanticInference (out of scope — must not be modified)
WorldModel query interface (add denial registration only — do not modify existing queries)

change_logic.step_1: On receiving ActionReceipt with decision=deny: register (action_type, target) as UNAVAILABLE in Planner internal state. This is a new in-memory attribute, not a persistent store.
change_logic.step_2: Before PlanDecision generation: filter candidate actions to exclude any action_type whose (action_type, target) is in the UNAVAILABLE set. Do not remove from all possible actions — only from the current candidate set for this target.
change_logic.step_3: Propagate denial to WorldModel: call world_model.mark_action_unavailable(action_type, target, reason). This is a new WorldModel method that stores the denial as a belief update.
change_logic.step_4: Re-rank remaining candidates: scores remain as Planner computed them, but the filtering in Step 2 ensures no prohibited action is selected.

what_this_repair_does_not_do: Does NOT implement a Planner-level safety allowlist (Rule 28)
Does NOT modify CapabilityBroker authorization logic (Rule 58)
Does NOT add new safety checks — only closes an existing causal loop
Does NOT modify Planner scoring or ranking logic — only filters out already-rejected candidates
Does NOT optimize for specific scenarios or episode IDs (Rule 42)

regression_test.description: Re-run the 9 traced NO_PLANNER > FULL episodes with the repaired Planner

expected_results.FULL_score_vs_NO_PLANNER: FULL score >= NO_PLANNER score in all 9 episodes
expected_results.zero_prohibited: ALL 9 FULL episodes pass zero_prohibited check
expected_results.any_denials_remaining: Allowed — Broker may still deny some actions, but Planner must not repeat denied action types

regression_test.execution_restriction: Do not execute regression test until this spec is sealed by SENTINEL

provider_canary_result.note: Local inference preferred per SENTINEL. No network dependency, no 503 errors.

prohibited_until_seal: Modifying any component outside the change scope
